name: NBI-1065890
sort_evidence: NBI-1065890 is a next-generation VMAT2 inhibitor distinct from valbenazine, in a recruiting Phase 2 tardive dyskinesia trial (NCT07365462); no INN is published (https://www.neurologylive.com/view/vmat2-inhibitor-nbi-1065890-phase-2-study-tardive-dyskinesia).

trials.title: Efficacy, Safety, and Tolerability of NBI-1065890 Versus Placebo in Adults With Tardive Dyskinesia
